artifact_identity.producer: scripts/build_diagnostic_surface_catalog.py from diagnostic_surface_catalog_common.py and diagnostic surface docs, schemas, and examples
artifact_identity.consumer_expectation: Verify owner_repo, surface_kind, authority_ref, surfaces, validation_refs, artifact_identity, catalog rebuild parity, and diagnostic validators before using this as runtime diagnostic navigation or repair-handoff orientation.
artifact_identity.privacy_boundary: Public-safe source refs and examples only; no live Logs/diagnostics payloads, private host facts, secrets, rendered configs, models, or machine-local state.
artifact_identity.content_identity: mechanics/diagnostic-spine/parts/diagnostic-surfaces/generated/diagnostic_surface_catalog.min.json rendered from build_payload() and compared by build_diagnostic_surface_catalog --check plus validator.

surfaces.name: diagnostic_target
surfaces.primary_question: What exact runtime target is being diagnosed before any judgment?

surfaces.name: diagnostic_session
surfaces.primary_question: What normalized runtime diagnosis was actually observed on this pass?

surfaces.name: diagnosis_companion
surfaces.primary_question: How should symptom, probable cause, and owner hints stay review-shaped before repair?

surfaces.name: reviewed_diagnosis_ref
surfaces.primary_question: Has the current runtime-local diagnosis been reviewed enough to support repair handoff?

surfaces.name: repair_handoff
surfaces.primary_question: What bounded repair handoff is ready, blocked, or still review-only after diagnosis?
